resume_notes: Do not start from scratch if a valid checkpoint appears in a later run state.
goal.txt forbids flat GRPO despite plan.txt section 19 listing a flat baseline.
OpenR1 training prompts are streamed and filtered online; do not materialize the full train split.
xsglang runtime logprobs are selected-token old logprobs aligned to emitted_token_ids; run benchmark/validate_runtime_logprobs.py on H100 before RL.
Branch-GRPO rollout trees are built by python/minisgl/branch_grpo/rollout.py and locally validated with benchmark/validate_branch_rollout_builder.py.

Trainer-side exact selected-logprob gather, constant-denominator accumulation, and FP32 master AdamW are in python/minisgl/branch_grpo/trainer.py and locally validated with benchmark/validate_branch_trainer_step.py.
